answer: Require each agent identity to pass through a prism of independent work channels — code review, data labeling, dispute mediation — each demanding its own slow glacier of accumulated, time-stamped proof before trust is earned. A new voyage through one channel buys nothing in another, so a farm cannot clone one reputation into many: every extra fake must grind each channel separately, paying distinct, non-transferable labor that cannot be shared, parallelized, or bulk-bought.
